daily_summary: Pfizer wins €1.9 billion COVID vaccine case with Poland, Romania. - Pfizer and Bio NTech stop U.S. COVID vaccine study. - Pfizer pulls back from South San Francisco. - Pfizer halts COVID shot trial due to low enrollment.
Pfizer closing research site to reduce costs. - Trump administration prepares tariffs on drugmakers.
Belgium court orders Poland, Romania to honor vaccine deal.
Pfizer pauses updated COVID-19 vaccine trial. - Pfizer stock drops amid trial pause.

Pfizer accelerates transformation with Seagen, Metsera acquisitions. - Pfizer deals with lower COVID revenues, halts vaccine trial. - Pfizer advances m RNA and Lyme vaccine programs. - Pfizer reports over 100 pipeline candidates. - Pfizer implements cost cutting and balance sheet adjustments.
Pfizer to hold virtual 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders.
Pfizer seeks drug development partnerships with Chinese biotech companies.
Trellus Health extends Pfizer IBD digital application licensing agreement. - Trellus Health signs renewal of licensing deal with Pfizer.
Pfizer's non-oncology portfolio in focus ahead of Q1 earnings.
Pfizer's pipeline shows progress with positive data. - Pfizer faces revenue decline amid COVID hangover.
Pfizer signals pivot toward obesity drug programs. - Pfizer reports revenue decline tied to COVID product sales. - Pfizer takes US$4.4b impairment charge.
FDA grants priority review to PADCEV and Keytruda combo.

Pfizer PADCEV Keytruda gets FDA Priority Review for bladder cancer. - Pfizer to present oncology pipeline data at ASCO 2026. - FDA grants priority review to Merck's Keytruda combo with Pfizer's Padcev.

Pfizer's weight loss drug available for pre-order in China. - Pfizer's oncology data to focus on future cancer revenue. - Pfizer CFO discusses oncology, obesity, and growth strategy. - Pfizer declares second-quarter 2026 dividend.
Pfizer reports Phase 2b results for GLP-1 anti-obesity candidate. - Pfizer announces preliminary results from its Annual Shareholder Meeting.

Pfizer and Bristol Myers Squibb to offer Eliquis via Mark Cuban's pharmacy. - Pfizer and Bristol Myers Squibb make Eliquis available via Mark Cuban's company. - Pfizer and Bristol Myers Squibb offer Eliquis at transparent pricing.
Pfizer tests transparent Eliquis pricing with Cost Plus Drugs.

Pfizer shareholders reject independent chair proposal at AGM. - Pfizer to supply atirmociclib for Relay Therapeutics' breast cancer trial. - Pfizer faces competition from Novo Nordisk in obesity market.

Pfizer settles patent lawsuits for Vyndamax with three generic drugmakers. - Pfizer extends effective U.S. patent for heart drug Vyndamax to June 2031. - Pfizer stock dips following announcement of Vyndamax patent settlement agreements. - Pfizer signs supply deal with Relay Therapeutics for Phase III plan.
